Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: Stiffness
Fields.Description: How strongly the bones spring back to the pose (0 to 1).

Fields.Name: Damping
Fields.Description: How fast the jiggle dies down (0 to 1).

Fields.Name: Max Elongation
Fields.Description: How far a bone can stretch from its pose length, as a fraction.

Fields.Name: Max Compression
Fields.Description: How far a bone can shrink from its pose length, as a fraction.

Fields.Name: Propagate To Children
Fields.Description: Whether a bone's jiggle moves its children too.

Fields.Name: Affect Siblings
Fields.Description: Whether the bones pull on their siblings.

Fields.Name: Rotate Bones For Skinning
Fields.Description: Whether the parent bones are rotated to follow the jiggle, so the skin follows it.
